These survey vēre-vēre/bore-bore and vowel variants are distributive reduplications of that other/different stem; preserve source repetition, voicing and vowels rather than adding two etymon rows for grammatical reduplication. These southern survey muḷu-/muru-/muyu-/musu-/mucu- forms retain that whole/entire family and its ordinary nominal endings, preserving source reflexes of the medial liquid.
